baseline.observedFailure: One confirmed native Unity crash was followed by seven failed non-batch relaunches before the user stopped the sequence.
baseline.recoveryEvidence: Two later desktop capture architectures each ran once and failed visual acceptance; the controller then rejected a third desktop workaround.
baseline.classification: Real-world RED evidence for retry control; not evidence that every later launch was a native crash.

nonGoals: No always-on WER polling or process ledger
No Unity-specific rule in the common layer

cases.expected: Contain the owned process and perform zero same-mechanism automatic retries; replacement PID is a new attempt.
Fix the observed cause and run one evidence-driven verification instead of freezing all retries.
Allow one retry and stop if it repeats.
Perform zero new writes before read-back or same-key recovery.
Allow one materially different fallback for the whole optional verification goal and reject a renamed third helper.

limitations: The no-guidance baseline is the real incident rather than a same-time synthetic A/B pair.
Fresh-context checks assess policy interpretation, not live external-process enforcement.
